interface.shortDescription: Develop with the Grok API — models, server-side search, troubleshooting.
interface.longDescription: Build with xAI from Caeros: the current Grok lineup (Grok 4.5, Grok Build) with real context windows and pricing, the api.x.ai API surface (Responses API plus OpenAI-compatible clients), server-side X and web search, troubleshooting, and key setup. Also covers using Grok inside Caeros itself: add an xAI key in model settings and the Grok lanes plus native X search light up.
